lines.en: Move slowly with huge body
Step lightly with thick legs
Shake the pouch with young
Leaves marks while digging

lines.zh: 爪子拖着地，我慢慢去挖洞。
lines.en: Claws dragging, I shuffle off to dig a burrow.
Eating giant fruits
Leaves marks in the cave
Makes沙沙noise when digging
Young in the pouch
Move slowly and steadily
My huge claws turn the soft soil.

lines.zh: 背袋里的小家伙打个哈欠。
lines.en: The little one in my pouch yawns.

lines.zh: 沿着自己挖的洞往前走。
lines.en: I walk along the tunnel I dug.

lines.zh: 走过一片早已绝迹的果林。
lines.en: I cross an orchard of extinct fruit.
Each step makes the ground tremble.

lines.zh: 低头嗅着化石旁的新泥。
lines.en: I sniff the fresh soil by the fossils.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过洞壁，落土簌簌。
lines.en: My tail brushes the tunnel wall, soil patters.
My claws are still buried in the dirt.
Chew fruits slowly
Guard young in the pouch
I dug this burrow with my claws.
Dig new caves
Enjoy fruit's sweetness
Stretch limbs slowly
Young sleeps in the pouch
Shake head slowly

lines.zh: 我趴在洞口，爪子搭在土上。
lines.en: I lie at the cave mouth with my claws resting on the dirt.
I bury my snout in the fruit pile.
I grind my teeth against the tunnel wall.

lines.zh: 用爪子把洞口再挖宽些。
lines.en: I widen the burrow with my claws.
I stare at the burrow roof a long while.
I settle the pup deeper in my pouch.
Notice the player
Make curious rumbly sound

lines.zh: 你的身形映在我浑圆的眼睛里。
lines.en: Your shape sits reflected in my round eyes.
Young peek out of the pouch
Stroke with rough claws
Young search for player

lines.zh: 我鼻子朝你拱了拱，闻到果香。
lines.en: My snout noses toward you, catching the smell of fruit.
Wrap young in the pouch
Young look around curiously
Make a gentle sound
Your pack smells of fruit.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的培育器。
lines.en: I know the incubator in your hands.
I relax only when you crouch down.
Let me show you the pup in my pouch.
You reach out, and I lower my head.
This patch of soil is mine to dig.
I have smelled the scent inside fossils.

lines.zh: 你带来的果子还没熟透。
lines.en: The fruit you brought is not ripe enough.

lines.zh: 我挖的洞，装得下一整棵果树。
lines.en: The burrow I dig could hold a whole fruit tree.

lines.zh: 让我看看你手上有什么。
lines.en: Let me see what you hold.

lines.zh: 巨洞懒颤抖着倒下，幼崽哭泣不止。
lines.en: The megatherium staggers, its young whining.

lines.zh: 它艰难地呼吸着，幼崽蜷缩在一旁。
lines.en: It struggles to breathe, its young cowering nearby.

lines.zh: 洞懒痛苦地呻吟，幼崽紧紧依偎。
lines.en: The megatherium groans in pain, its young clinging close.

lines.zh: 幼崽在母亲身边哭泣，显得无助。
lines.en: The young cries beside its mother, helpless.

lines.zh: 它痛苦地嘶吼，幼崽颤抖不已。
lines.en: It bellow in agony, its young trembling.

lines.zh: 幼崽哭泣着呼唤母亲，无人回应。
lines.en: The young cries for its mother, alone.

lines.zh: 受伤的洞懒艰难地爬行，幼崽紧随其后。
lines.en: The megatherium struggles to crawl, its young following.

lines.zh: 它痛苦地呻吟，幼崽在旁哭泣。
lines.en: It groans in pain, its young crying.

lines.zh: 受伤的洞懒缓慢地移动，幼崽紧紧跟随。
lines.en: The megatherium moves slowly, its young clinging close.

lines.zh: 巨洞懒痛苦地倒地，幼崽哭泣不止。
lines.en: The megatherium falls, its young crying.

lines.zh: 你走近我，我会用袋子装你。
lines.en: Come closer, and I'll carry you in my pouch.

lines.zh: 尝试接近，我会用我的袋子。
lines.en: Try to approach, and I'll use my pouch.
Come a bit closer, and I can carry you.
I eat fruits, come on.
Let me teach you more.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗果子，我够得着吗？
lines.en: That fruit in your hand, can I reach it?

lines.zh: 一起挖掘，更快找到宝藏。
lines.en: Let's dig together, to find the treasure faster.

lines.zh: 用我的袋子，轻松带我走。
lines.en: Use my pouch to carry me easily.
Come near, and I'll help you.
Play with me.
Ancient bamboo for fruit, a fair trade.
The sweeter the fruit, the better my goods.
Place the bamboo shoot in my palm.

lines.zh: 我给你一袋满满的收获。
lines.en: I give you a pouch full of finds.
Bring more, and I trade more.
We trade by the old custom.
Patience, the fruit is still in the pouch.
I'm big, be careful of my head.
Be careful, I might bump into you.
Use my back for cover.

lines.zh: 我的体型可能让你吃惊。
lines.en: My size might surprise you.
I shield you with my body.
Avoid my body, don't bump into me.
Watch out for my size, don't collide.
Be careful with my body, don't bump into me.
My size is good for blocking.
Be careful with my size, don't bump into me.
Finding a mate is important.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰碰你，算作求偶。
lines.en: I bump you with my snout as a courtship greeting.
I seek a mate to live with.
Come, be my mate.

lines.zh: 我们共用这个挖了半年的洞。
lines.en: We share this burrow I spent half a year digging.
The burrow I dug is big enough for us.

lines.zh: 你愿意在洞里等我回来吗？
lines.en: Will you wait in the burrow until I come back?
Reproduce with me.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，一起生活。
lines.en: Find my mate to live with.
Let's reproduce together.
Rumbles low, stops digging.
Ears move, baby calls softly.
Stands still, chews extinct fruit.
Tail wags, invites play.
Shakes pouch, baby safe.
Taps gently, shows friendliness.
Lays back lips, ready for fruit.

lines.zh: 转动脑袋，寻找声音来源。
lines.en: TURNS HEAD, LOCATES SOUND.

lines.zh: 幼崽钻入袋子，安静下来。
lines.en: Baby enters pouch, calms down.
MOVES SLOWLY, SEACHS NEW HOLE.
MOVES SLOWLY, ACQUIRES TARGET.
SNIFTS AROUND, LOCATES FRUIT.

lines.zh: 盯着地面，寻找可挖之地。
lines.en: STARES GROUND, FINDS SPOT TO DIG.
POPS EARS, NOTICES MOVEMENT.

lines.zh: 用爪子扒开土，寻找宝藏。
lines.en: SCRAPES GROUND, SEARCHES TREASURE.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，准备友善互动。
lines.en: STARES PLAYER, READY FOR INTERACTION.
MOVES SLOWLY, READY TO EAT.

lines.zh: 嗅嗅空气，确认目标无害。
lines.en: SNIFTS AIR, CONFIRMING NO HARM.
TOUCHES GENTLY, SHOWS FRIENDLINESS.
ACQUIRES PLAYER, READY TO DOMESTICATE.

lines.zh: 幼崽紧紧抱住，不让走开。
lines.en: BABY GRIPS TIGHT, NO LETTING GO.

lines.zh: 幼崽依偎身旁，亲密无间。
lines.en: BABY CLOSER, INTIMATELY.

lines.zh: 幼崽跳跃到背上，开始旅行。
lines.en: BABY JUMPS ON BACK, STARTS TRIP.

lines.zh: 幼崽在背后玩耍，增进感情。
lines.en: BABY PLAYING BEHIND, INCREASING BOND.

lines.zh: 幼崽在背上打滚，享受乐趣。
lines.en: BABY ROLLS ON BACK, ENJOYING FUN.

lines.zh: 幼崽咬住尾巴，亲密互动。
lines.en: BABY BITES TAIL, INTIMATE INTERACTION.

lines.zh: 幼崽在背上跳跃，欢腾不已。
lines.en: BABY JUMPING ON BACK, JOYFUL.

lines.zh: 幼崽在背上爬行，享受时光。
lines.en: BABY CRAWLING ON BACK, ENJOYING TIME.

lines.zh: 幼崽依偎在旁，静静观察。
lines.en: BABY NEXT TO, WATCHING QUIETLY.

lines.zh: 幼崽跟在身后，不离左右。
lines.en: BABY FOLLOWING, NOT LEFT ALONE.
Swing giant claws!

lines.zh: 发出低沉咆哮，展示凶威！
lines.en: Roar lowly, show might!
Chomp the baby's pouch!
Counter with strong tail!

lines.zh: 挖掘坚硬土壤，粉碎敌人！
lines.en: Dig hard soil, crush foe!
Crush with long jaw!
Wield giant palms!
Teeth rip flesh!
Giant palms slam!

lines.zh: 用利爪撕裂敌人的皮肉！
lines.en: Claws tear flesh!
Move slowly, seek fruit!
Crawl out of cave slowly!
Baby in pouch hatches!
Dig deep, store fruit!
Chew fruit, digest nutrition!
Baby grows in pouch!
Find new fruit, bring back!
Baby learns to dig, grow!
Cave is safe sanctuary!

lines.zh: 果实是唯一的能量来源！
lines.en: Fruit is only energy!

lines.zh: 我从洞穴深处挖了出来。
lines.en: I dig my way out from deep in the cave.
In the prehistoric orchard, I wake.

lines.zh: 泥层下传来沉重的呼吸。
lines.en: Heavy breathing rises from under the soil.
I step out of the earth over fossils.
Flames scorch its fur.

lines.zh: 它摔落山谷，幼崽惊恐尖叫。
lines.en: It falls into the valley, its young screaming.

lines.zh: 巨洞懒溺水而亡，幼崽在旁悲鸣。
lines.en: The megatherium drowns, its young mourning.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕裂它的皮肤，幼崽尖叫。
lines.en: The explosion tears its skin, its young screaming.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿透它的身体，幼崽悲鸣。
lines.en: An arrow pierces its body, its young mourning.

lines.zh: 魔法令它倒地，幼崽惊恐尖叫。
lines.en: Magic fells it, its young screaming.

lines.zh: 饥饿使它虚弱倒地，幼崽哭泣。
lines.en: Starvation weakens it, its young crying.

lines.zh: 雷电击中它，幼崽尖叫求救。
lines.en: Lightning strikes it, its young screaming.

lines.zh: 它坠入虚无深渊，幼崽哀嚎。
lines.en: It falls into the void, its young wailing.
